hooks.name: Keep requirements honest
hooks.description: When UI copy changes, check that every quantum claim in the page still matches the model and the spec.

action.prompt: Compare the quantum claims in static/index.html (quantum panel, How to play, final screen) and static/app.js (hints, final screen, circuit labels) against app/quantum.py, app/spin.py and .kiro/specs/kirogotchi/requirements.md R3-R6. Report any mismatch and fix the copy, never the physics, unless the spec was changed on purpose.
